title: How to Get a Job on LinkedIn (Step-by-step)
description:
Most job seekers waste hours on job boards while recruiters are quietly searching LinkedIn for the exact role they want to fill. In this video I show you step-by-step how recruiters actually search, what makes your profile invisible, and the exact headline, About section, and experience bullets that get you found and messaged.

IN THIS VIDEO:
0:00 Why job boards fail (319 apps per role)
1:53 The visibility problem
3:50 How recruiter software actually works
4:56 The LinkedIn headline formula
5:54 About + Experience + Feature sections
8:15 The daily LinkedIn habit
10:59 What to do next

ABOUT ME:
I dropped out of university at 19 to build recruitment software and ATS systems used by hiring teams. For years I spoke to hundreds of hiring managers and recruiters every day, learning exactly how candidates get filtered, shortlisted, and hired from the inside. I started coaching friends through their job search using what I'd seen, then raised investment, built a software company, and hired my own team. I've seen hiring from every angle.

Today I help job seekers land offers faster using a proven 3-step system. I've coached hundreds of candidates into roles at firms like JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, EY, and PwC and many more.
